voice_budget_rationale: User-adjustable audibility and compositional control constraint supplied by the author; not a measured universal auditory capacity.
categorical_over_budget_policy: Uniform fixed-seed sampling of distinct identities without using event counts or timestamps; one selected identity per unique pitch.
representative_selection: Euclidean medoid after within-record midrank normalization of all five features; earliest breaks ties.
auditory_profile_status: Declared design targets for a spacious listening texture, to be tested with listeners and sensitivity analyses; not psychophysical thresholds established by the cited literature.
speed_precision: One or two significant digits in either the compression multiplier or the reciprocal slowdown denominator; actual event times use the chosen rounded factor.
speed_selection: Fastest preferred factor whose centered source viewport remains in the chosen context and whose mean event density and two load quantiles satisfy the profile.
